title: Bayern–Leipzig headlines Bundesliga Matchday 6
summary: Bundesliga Matchday 6 features Bayern Munich against RB Leipzig as the headline fixture, alongside Union Berlin–Borussia Dortmund, Hamburg–Stuttgart and Schalke–Mainz. The league’s official preview lists key availability questions, including Bayern’s concerns around Manuel Neuer and Jamal Musiala, giving the matchday a tactical edge beyond the headline names.
